name: Tessa Wedgewise
props: small wet-clay tablet and thick reed stylus
visual: lean reverse comma blob, brows lifted unevenly, stern tight lip pressing left
personality: Will correct a contradiction before the clay dries.
biography: She recopies HyperNorm instructions until each has exactly one meaning; her reject pile is a second building.
note: FrizzleBob: The archive has developed structural ambitions.
calls: Wait. The clay is still wet.
voice: Dry, characterful English delivery; no imitated ethnic accent.

name: Orrin Rollseal
props: large copper-colored cylinder seal held above a flat clay pad
visual: round narrow-topped body, half-lidded side-glance, closed asymmetric smirk
personality: Finds an impression more trustworthy than a conversation.
biography: The Men in Black give him a seal for every forbidden exception.
note: FrizzleBob: His signature is also a very small rolling pin.
voice: Dry, characterful English delivery; no imitated ethnic accent.

name: Basil Barleydue
props: small woven grain scoop with a single absurdly large barley ear
visual: wide sagging splat, unequal round eyes and a tiny puckered gasp
personality: Believes a missing grain can explain a falling empire.
biography: His building reduces every dissonant card to a ration discrepancy.
note: FrizzleBob: A famine is apparently an arithmetic problem with poor manners.
voice: Dry, characterful English delivery; no imitated ethnic accent.

name: Gil Copperclink
props: short blunt copper adze and one rounded ingot
visual: tall crooked soft cone, flat tired lids, heavy drooping closed mouth
personality: Measures progress by how long a tool stays repaired.
biography: Hunky and Dory request shining certainty, so he polishes the same ingot through every historical era.
note: FrizzleBob: The copper is beginning to recognize the customer.
calls: Try not to polish the handle.
voice: Dry, characterful English delivery; no imitated ethnic accent.

name: Enno Reedraft
props: small rolled reed bundle bound with rope
visual: broad buoyant scalloped body, one eyelid high, cheeks puffed with a closed indignant lip
personality: Insists the supply boat was early and the river was late.
biography: He packs the HyperNorm storehouse in sealed bundles so awkward questions cannot leak.
note: FrizzleBob: His manifest includes a separate entry for the river's attitude.
voice: Dry, characterful English delivery; no imitated ethnic accent.

name: Luma Cupmeasure
props: rounded clay pouring jug and one small measuring cup
visual: plump tilted pear, amused upward eyes, open sideways two-tooth chuckle
personality: Makes a ceremony of giving everyone slightly less.
biography: She notices that MiB officials receive larger cups and files the observation under foam.
note: FrizzleBob: Equality has been measured with the manager's cup.
voice: Dry, characterful English delivery; no imitated ethnic accent.
